ipeds_loc.title: IPEDS institutional directory (location, locale) via Urban Institute Education Data Portal

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2025 entering class); the residency split is from its residency table (in-state 11,577 / out-of-state 3,236 / international 211 applicants; 10,701 / 2,820 / 204 admitted; 2,494 / 167 / 36 enrolled). Undergraduate enrollment is 17,504 and the nonresident count is 212 ('Total Undergraduates' figures). SAT/ACT percentiles cover only the 7% (184) / 1% (24) of enrollees who submitted scores. The Common Data Set gives no GPA band below 2.50 (the breakdown sums to 100). Domestic early action closes 12/1 (notified 1/15); no early decision.

cds_test_policy.notes: Common Data Set (fall 2027): SAT or ACT marked 'required for some' (programs); the international admissions pages say SAT/ACT are optional.

cost.notes: First-year costs from the Common Data Set (2025-26); 2026-27 rates not found. Both need-based and non-need-based aid from the college itself are marked available to nonresidents; 10 nonresidents were awarded aid, average $16,000 (the Common Data Set lists a $300,000 total, which does not equal 10 x $16,000)
